cases.name: main thread (no agent_id): silent, exit 0, no state written
cases.cmd: printf '%s' '{"session_id":"rn-{{SID}}","hook_event_name":"PostToolUse","tool_name":"Read"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/run-notes.sh; echo "rc=$? state=$(ls /tmp/claude-runnotes-rn-{{SID}}-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: subagent outside a run, no state yet: python reads its prompt and caches `-` under the session and agent ids the bash regex read
cases.cmd: . {{KIT}}/lib/platform.sh; R={{FIX}}/rn-{{SID}}; kit_path R; mkdir -p $R/s/subagents && printf '%s\n' '{"type":"user","message":{"content":"Explore the repo."}}' > $R/s/subagents/agent-a3.jsonl && printf '%s' '{"session_id":"rn-{{SID}}","hook_event_name":"PostToolUse","tool_name":"Read","transcript_path":"'$R/s.jsonl'","agent_id":"a3"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/run-notes.sh; echo "rc=$? [$(cat /tmp/claude-runnotes-rn-{{SID}}-a3 2>/dev/null)]"

cases.name: subagent whose cached state is `-`: silent, the state left as is
agent_id held twice (a nested object): jq reads the top-level ids, the state is keyed on them
cases.cmd: . {{KIT}}/lib/platform.sh; R={{FIX}}/rn2-{{SID}}; kit_path R; mkdir -p $R/s/subagents && printf '%s\n' '{"type":"user","message":{"content":"Explore the repo."}}' > $R/s/subagents/agent-a5.jsonl && printf '%s' '{"tool_response":{"agent_id":"nested"},"session_id":"rn-{{SID}}","tool_name":"Agent","transcript_path":"'$R/s.jsonl'","agent_id":"a5"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/run-notes.sh; echo "rc=$? top=$(ls /tmp/claude-runnotes-rn-{{SID}}-a5 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') nested=$(ls /tmp/claude-runnotes-rn-{{SID}}-nested 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
